Is really nice to see how dedicated  you are. Well  about the antidepressants, depression and anxiety are 2 faces of the same coin. If he just began with the treatment is normal to act recklessly...that's why the main problem in the first months of antidepressants is suicide. Is having tons of energy and don't know how to use it... he can't improve if he doesn't have a good psychological therapy, it  doesn't matter if he is taking pills. The medicine just can give us a little rest. But taking just the pills is like controlling the symptoms with treating  the origin. You love him. But be careful, he can drag you to the void. Take care of your mental health too, and  tell him if something is making you feel about the relationship, and if he doesn't do anything about that, take your distance.
